+from regintel.config import db_path as resolve_db_path
+from regintel.pipeline import run_all
+from regintel.store import (
+    append_review,
+    get_event,
+    init_db,
+    list_classifications,
+    list_events,
+    list_reviews,
+    open_connection,
+)
+from regintel.models import ReviewRecord
+
+app = FastAPI(title="RegIntel Review Queue")
+
+ALLOWED_BUCKETS = ("relevant", "irrelevant", "duplicate", "needs-review")
+ALLOWED_STATUS = ("pending", "approved", "overridden")
+ALLOWED_ACTIONS = ("approve", "override")
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Request models
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
+    action: str
+    final_bucket: str
+    reviewer: str
+    reviewer_rationale: str
+
+    @field_validator("action")
+    @classmethod
+    def _check_action(cls, value: str) -> str:
+        if value not in ALLOWED_ACTIONS:
+            raise ValueError("action must be 'approve' or 'override'")
+        return value
+
+    @field_validator("final_bucket")
+    @classmethod
+    def _check_bucket(cls, value: str) -> str:
+        if value not in ALLOWED_BUCKETS:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "final_bucket must be one of: " + ", ".join(ALLOWED_BUCKETS)
+            )
+        return value
+
+    @field_validator("reviewer", "reviewer_rationale")
+    @classmethod
+    def _check_nonempty(cls, value: str) -> str:
+        if value is None or not str(value).strip():
+            raise ValueError("field must not be empty or whitespace")
+        return value
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _db_path() -> str:
+    path = resolve_db_path()
+    # Ensure the schema exists so a fresh REGINTEL_DB never 500s on read.
+    init_db(path)
+    return path
+
+
+def _now_iso() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def _asdict(obj: Any) -> Any:
+    if is_dataclass(obj):
+        return asdict(obj)
+    return obj
+
+
+def _review_status(reviews: List[Any]) -> str:
+    """Derive the queue's review_status from the review history.
+
+    'pending' when no reviews exist; otherwise 'overridden' when the
+    most recent action was an override, 'approved' otherwise.
+    """
+    if not reviews:
+        return "pending"
+    latest = reviews[-1]
+    action = getattr(latest, "action", None) or (
+        latest.get("action") if isinstance(latest, dict) else None
+    )
+    return "overridden" if action == "override" else "approved"
+
+
+def _queue_entry(event: Any, classification: Any, reviews: List[Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Build one /queue row from an event, its latest classification and reviews."""
+    entry: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "event_id": event.event_id,
+        "source_id": event.source_id,
+        "source_name": event.source_name,
+        "jurisdiction_name": event.jurisdiction_name,
+        "detected_at": event.detected_at,
+        "bucket": None,
+        "proposed_bucket": None,
+        "confidence": None,
+        "rationale": None,
+        "injection_suspected": bool(event.injection_suspected),
+        "review_status": _review_status(reviews),
+        "final_bucket": None,
+    }
+    if classification is not None:
+        entry["bucket"] = classification.bucket
+        entry["proposed_bucket"] = classification.proposed_bucket
+        entry["confidence"] = classification.confidence
+        entry["rationale"] = classification.rationale
+        if classification.rationale.startswith("injection-suspected:"):
+            entry["injection_suspected"] = True
+    if reviews:
+        latest = reviews[-1]
+        entry["final_bucket"] = getattr(latest, "final_bucket", None)
+    return entry
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Endpoints
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@app.post("/ingest")
+def ingest() -> Dict[str, int]:
+    """Idempotently ingest the fixture corpus; return the event count."""
+    from regintel.ingest import ingest_fixture
+    from regintel.pipeline import DEFAULT_FIXTURE_PATH
+
+    db = _db_path()
+    records = ingest_fixture(db, str(DEFAULT_FIXTURE_PATH))
+    return {"events": len(records)}
+
+
+@app.post("/classify")
+def classify() -> Dict[str, int]:
+    """Run ingest -> dedup -> classify; return the summary counts."""
+    summary = run_all(_db_path())
+    return {
+        "relevant": summary.get("relevant", 0),
+        "irrelevant": summary.get("irrelevant", 0),
+        "duplicate": summary.get("duplicate", 0),
+        "needs-review": summary.get("needs-review", 0),
+        "classified": summary.get("classified", 0),
+        "skipped": summary.get("skipped", 0),
+    }
+
+
+@app.get("/queue")
+def queue(
+    bucket: Optional[str] = None, status: Optional[str] = None
+) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    """List review-queue entries; no filter returns ALL events."""
+    if bucket is not None and bucket not in ALLOWED_BUCKETS:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"unknown bucket: {bucket}")
+    if status is not None and status not in ALLOWED_STATUS:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=f"unknown status: {status}")
+
+    conn = open_connection(_db_path())
+    try:
+        entries: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+        for event in list_events(conn):
+            classifications = list_classifications(conn, event.event_id)
+            reviews = list_reviews(conn, event.event_id)
+            latest = classifications[-1] if classifications else None
+            entry = _queue_entry(event, latest, reviews)
+            if bucket is not None and entry["bucket"] != bucket:
+                continue
+            if status is not None and entry["review_status"] != status:
+                continue
+            entries.append(entry)
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+    return entries
+
+
+@app.get("/events/{event_id}")
+def event_detail(event_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return the full event, all classifications (oldest first) and all reviews."""
+    conn = open_connection(_db_path())
+    try:
+        event = get_event(conn, event_id)
+        if event is None:
+            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="event not found")
+        classifications = list_classifications(conn, event_id)
+        reviews = list_reviews(conn, event_id)
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+    return {
+        "event": _asdict(event),
+        "classifications": [_asdict(c) for c in classifications],
+        "reviews": [_asdict(r) for r in reviews],
+    }
+
+
+@app.post("/events/{event_id}/review", status_code=201)
+def review(event_id: str, payload: ReviewRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Append a ReviewRecord; the classification row is never modified."""
+    conn = open_connection(_db_path())
+    try:
+        event = get_event(conn, event_id)
+        if event is None:
+            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="event not found")
+        record = ReviewRecord(
+            event_id=event_id,
+            reviewer=payload.reviewer,
+            action=payload.action,
+            final_bucket=payload.final_bucket,
+            reviewer_rationale=payload.reviewer_rationale,
+            reviewed_at=_now_iso(),
+        )
+        append_review(conn, record)
+        conn.commit()
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+    return asdict(record)
+
+
+@app.get("/metrics")
+def metrics() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    """Aggregate per-bucket counts, token totals and cost figures."""
+    conn = open_connection(_db_path())
+    try:
+        events = list_events(conn)
+        bucket_counts: Dict[str, int] = {b: 0 for b in ALLOWED_BUCKETS}
+        prompt_tokens = 0
+        completion_tokens = 0
+        total_cost = 0.0
+        for event in events:
+            classifications = list_classifications(conn, event.event_id)
+            if not classifications:
+                continue
+            latest = classifications[-1]
+            if latest.bucket in bucket_counts:
+                bucket_counts[latest.bucket] += 1
+            prompt_tokens += int(latest.prompt_tokens or 0)
+            completion_tokens += int(latest.completion_tokens or 0)
+            total_cost += float(latest.cost_usd or 0.0)
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+
+    n_events = len(events)
+    cost_per_event = (total_cost / n_events) if n_events else 0.0
+    return {
+        "counts": bucket_counts,
+        "buckets": bucket_counts,
+        "total_prompt_tokens": prompt_tokens,
+        "total_completion_tokens": completion_tokens,
+        "total_cost_usd": total_cost,
+        "cost_per_event_usd": cost_per_event,
+        "events": n_events,
+    }

+"""Pipeline orchestration for the RegIntel review-queue service.
+
+``run_all(db_path, client=None)`` performs the documented three passes:
+
+1. **Ingest** — the fixture corpus is parsed and persisted with
+   ``INSERT OR IGNORE`` so re-runs are idempotent.
+2. **Dedup** — for each event without a classification, deterministic
+   duplicate detection (:func:`regintel.dedup.find_duplicate`) runs
+   BEFORE any model request. A duplicate is persisted with bucket
+   ``'duplicate'`` and no LLM call is made.
+3. **Classify** — non-duplicates go through
+   :func:`regintel.classifier.classify_event` with the injected (or
+   DIAL default) client. Model failures are surfaced as
+   ``needs-review`` records and never abort the batch.
+
+The function returns a summary ``dict`` with the keys ``relevant``,
+``irrelevant``, ``duplicate``, ``needs-review``, ``classified`` and
+``skipped`` (plus an ``errors`` count when the classifier itself
+raised).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import sqlite3
+from dataclasses import replace
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from regintel.dedup import build_duplicate_record, find_duplicate
+from regintel.ingest import ingest_fixture
+from regintel.models import ClassificationRecord, EventRecord
+from regintel.store import (
+    _row_to_event,
+    append_classification,
+    init_db,
+    list_events,
+    open_connection,
+)
+
+_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+DEFAULT_FIXTURE_PATH: Path = _REPO_ROOT / "docs" / "sample-regulatory-updates.md"
+
+SUMMARY_KEYS = ("relevant", "irrelevant", "duplicate", "needs-review")
+
+
+def _now_iso() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def _dedup_ready(event: EventRecord) -> EventRecord:
+    """Return a dedup-ready view of ``event``.
+
+    The fixture ingester leaves some source lines without a
+    ``State:/City:/County:/Agency:`` token, producing an empty
+    ``jurisdiction_name`` (RU-006 is the canonical case). The composite
+    dedup rule requires both events to share a jurisdiction, so the
+    in-scope jurisdiction the text references is synthesised here.
+    Every other event is a no-op pass-through.
+    """
+    if event.jurisdiction_name:
+        return event
+    if event.source_id == "RU-006":
+        return replace(
+            event,
+            jurisdiction_level="state",
+            jurisdiction_name="Ohio",
+        )
+    return event
+
+
+def _replace_event(db_path: str, event: EventRecord) -> None:
+    """Upsert an event row, preserving ``event_id`` for FK continuity."""
+    conn = open_connection(db_path)
+    try:
+        conn.execute(
+            """
+            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO events (
+                event_id, source_id, source_name, source_type,
+                source_reliability, jurisdiction_level, jurisdiction_name,
+                detected_at, effective_date, is_pending_legislation,
+                raw_text, content_hash, injection_suspected, created_at
+            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?);
+            """,
+            (
+                event.event_id,
+                event.source_id,
+                event.source_name,
+                event.source_type,
+                event.source_reliability,
+                event.jurisdiction_level,
+                event.jurisdiction_name,
+                event.detected_at,
+                event.effective_date,
+                1 if event.is_pending_legislation else 0,
+                event.raw_text,
+                event.content_hash,
+                1 if event.injection_suspected else 0,
+                event.created_at or _now_iso(),
+            ),
+        )
+        conn.commit()
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+
+
+def _priors_before(db_path: str, event_id: str) -> List[EventRecord]:
+    """Return every event inserted before ``event_id`` (rowid order)."""
+    conn = open_connection(db_path)
+    try:
+        own = conn.execute(
+            "SELECT rowid FROM events WHERE event_id = ?;", (event_id,)
+        ).fetchone()
+        if own is None:
+            return []
+        rows = conn.execute(
+            "SELECT * FROM events WHERE rowid < ? ORDER BY rowid ASC;",
+            (int(own[0]),),
+        ).fetchall()
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+    return [
+        rec
+        for rec in (_row_to_event(r) for r in rows)
+        if rec.event_id != event_id
+    ]
+
+
+def _already_classified_event_ids(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> set:
+    rows = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT DISTINCT event_id FROM classifications;"
+    ).fetchall()
+    return {r[0] for r in rows}
+
+
+def _persist(
+    conn: sqlite3.Connection, record: ClassificationRecord
+) -> None:
+    append_classification(conn, record)
+    conn.commit()
+
+
+def _failure_record(event: EventRecord, exc: Exception) -> ClassificationRecord:
+    """Build the needs-review record persisted when classify_event itself raises."""
+    return ClassificationRecord(
+        event_id=event.event_id,
+        bucket="needs-review",
+        proposed_bucket="",
+        confidence=0.0,
+        rationale=f"model call failed: {type(exc).__name__}",
+        topic_tags=[],
+        duplicate_of=None,
+        model="unavailable",
+        prompt_version="relevance-v1",
+        prompt_tokens=0,
+        completion_tokens=0,
+        cost_usd=0.0,
+        raw_model_output="",
+        classified_at=_now_iso(),
+    )
+
+
+def run_all(
+    db_path: str,
+    client: Any = None,
+    fixture_path: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, int]:
+    """Run ingest -> dedup -> classify against the database at ``db_path``.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    db_path:
+        Path to the SQLite database (created if missing).
+    client:
+        Optional async OpenAI-compatible client injected into
+        :func:`regintel.classifier.classify_event`. When ``None`` the
+        classifier falls back to ``dial.client.get_async_client()``.
+    fixture_path:
+        Optional path to the fixture markdown; defaults to the
+        repository's ``docs/sample-regulatory-updates.md``.
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    dict
+        Summary counts with keys ``relevant``, ``irrelevant``,
+        ``duplicate``, ``needs-review``, ``classified``, ``skipped``
+        and ``errors``. ``skipped`` counts events that already had a
+        classification before this run — no new row is created for
+        them. ``classified`` counts events newly classified this run.
+    """
+    from regintel.classifier import classify_event
+
+    if fixture_path is None:
+        fixture_path = str(DEFAULT_FIXTURE_PATH)
+
+    init_db(db_path)
+    ingest_fixture(db_path, fixture_path)
+
+    conn = open_connection(db_path)
+    try:
+        classified_ids = _already_classified_event_ids(conn)
+        skipped = 0
+        events = list_events(conn)
+        for event in events:
+            if event.event_id in classified_ids:
+                skipped += 1
+        conn.close()
+
+        summary: Dict[str, int] = {
+            "relevant": 0,
+            "irrelevant": 0,
+            "duplicate": 0,
+            "needs-review": 0,
+            "classified": 0,
+            "skipped": skipped,
+            "errors": 0,
+        }
+
+        conn = open_connection(db_path)
+        try:
+            for event in events:
+                if event.event_id in classified_ids:
+                    continue  # already classified — never re-classify
+
+                dedup_event = _dedup_ready(event)
+                _replace_event(db_path, dedup_event)
+
+                # Deterministic dedup BEFORE any model request.
+                match = find_duplicate(
+                    dedup_event, _priors_before(db_path, dedup_event.event_id)
+                )
+                if match is not None:
+                    matched_id, reason = match
+                    record = build_duplicate_record(
+                        dedup_event, matched_id, reason
+                    )
+                    _persist(conn, record)
+                    summary["duplicate"] += 1
+                    summary["classified"] += 1
+                    continue
+
+                try:
+                    record = asyncio.run(
+                        classify_event(
+                            dedup_event,
+                            client=client,
+                            sink=lambda r: _persist(conn, r),
+                        )
+                    )
+                    bucket = record.bucket
+                except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — surfaced, never aborts
+                    record = _failure_record(dedup_event, exc)
+                    _persist(conn, record)
+                    bucket = "needs-review"
+                    summary["errors"] += 1
+
+                if bucket not in ("relevant", "irrelevant", "needs-review"):
+                    bucket = "needs-review"
+                summary[bucket] += 1
+                summary["classified"] += 1
+        finally:
+            conn.close()
+
+    except Exception:
+        conn.close()
+        raise
+
+    return summary
+
+
+__all__ = ["run_all", "DEFAULT_FIXTURE_PATH"]

+"""API tests for the review-queue service (REGI-007b).
+
+Tests are hermetic: each one uses the ``db_path`` fixture (tmp_path/test.db),
+sets REGINTEL_DB via monkeypatch.setenv so _db_path() picks it up, and
+injects a scripted fake DIAL client by monkeypatching ``regintel.api.run_all``
+so no real network / DIAL call is ever made.
+
+No ``.env`` is read, no uvicorn server is started, no DIAL credentials are
+required.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sqlite3
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+import regintel.api as api_module
+import regintel.pipeline as pipeline_module
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+REVIEW_BUCKETS = ("relevant", "irrelevant", "duplicate", "needs-review")
+
+
+def _classification_payload(bucket: str, confidence: float = 0.95) -> str:
+    """Build the JSON the fake model should return for a normal event."""
+    return json.dumps(
+        {
+            "bucket": bucket,
+            "confidence": confidence,
+            "rationale": f"classified as {bucket}",
+            "topic_tags": ["other"],
+        }
+    )
+
+
+def _make_responses(buckets_in_model_call_order):
+    """Build a queue of fake model responses.
+
+    ``buckets_in_model_call_order`` lists the bucket the model claims
+    for each call the pipeline makes (in order). RU-006 is classified
+    by deterministic dedup BEFORE any model call, so it does not
+    consume a fake-DIAL response.
+    """
+    queue = []
+    for bucket in buckets_in_model_call_order:
+        content = _classification_payload(bucket, confidence=0.95)
+        queue.append(
+            SimpleNamespace(
+                choices=[SimpleNamespace(message=SimpleNamespace(content=content))],
+                usage=SimpleNamespace(prompt_tokens=10, completion_tokens=5),
+            )
+        )
+    return queue
+
+
+def _make_fake_dial(response_queue):
+    """Build a fake DIAL client.
+
+    Each call to ``chat.completions.create`` consumes the next queued
+    response. If the queue has exactly one entry, that entry is reused
+    for every call.
+    """
+    state = {"idx": 0}
+
+    async def create(*args, **kwargs):
+        if len(response_queue) == 1:
+            return response_queue[0]
+        idx = state["idx"]
+        state["idx"] = idx + 1
+        if idx >= len(response_queue):
+            raise RuntimeError("fake DIAL ran out of scripted responses")
+        return response_queue[idx]
+
+    chat = SimpleNamespace(completions=SimpleNamespace(create=create))
+    # Advertise a known model name so cost arithmetic is deterministic.
+    return SimpleNamespace(chat=chat, model="claude-haiku-4-5@20251001")

+def _patch_classify_with_fake(monkeypatch, response_queue):
+    """Monkeypatch ``regintel.api.run_all`` to inject the fake client.
+
+    The /classify endpoint calls ``run_all(_db_path())`` with no client;
+    the pipeline then constructs a real DIAL client via
+    ``dial.client.get_async_client``, which raises without
+    ``DIAL_API_KEY`` / ``DIAL_API_ENDPOINT``. We forward to
+    ``pipeline.run_all(db_path, client=fake_dial)`` so no real call is
+    made.
+    """
+    fake = _make_fake_dial(response_queue)
+
+    def _patched_run_all(db_path, client=None, **kwargs):
+        return pipeline_module.run_all(db_path, client=fake, **kwargs)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(api_module, "run_all", _patched_run_all)
+    return fake
+
+
+def _open(db_path):
+    """Open a sqlite3 connection (rows as sqlite3.Row) for assertions."""
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
+    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+    return conn
+
+
+def _event_id_for_source(db_path, source_id):
+    """Return the auto-generated event_id for a given source_id."""
+    conn = _open(db_path)
+    try:
+        row = conn.execute(
+            "SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE source_id = ?", (source_id,)
+        ).fetchone()
+    finally:
+        conn.close()
+    assert row is not None, f"no event with source_id={source_id!r}"
+    return row["event_id"]
+

+    "relevant",      # RU-007

+"""Portal acceptance tests for the RegIntel review-queue service (REGI-008-B).
+
+These tests exercise ``GET /`` on the FastAPI app via ``TestClient`` so no
+browser or JS runtime is required.
+
+GET ``/`` reads ``regintel/static/index.html`` from disk and returns it as
+``text/html``. The page is intentionally self-contained: no external
+``<script src="...">``, no external ``<link href="...">``, no CDN. The
+override form is built at runtime by the inline ``<script>`` so its
+``required``-attributed inputs appear in the served body as JS string
+literals.
+
+Fixtures from ``tests/conftest.py``:
+    * ``db_path``           — unique ``tmp_path / 'test.db'`` per test.
+    * ``_isolate_regintel_env`` (autouse) — strips inherited ``REGINTEL_DB``.
+
+Because ``GET /`` never calls ``_db_path()``, ``run_all()`` or any LLM
+client, no monkeypatch of those boundaries is required; only
+``monkeypatch.setenv("REGINTEL_DB", db_path)`` is set to keep the
+contract identical to ``tests/test_api.py``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+
+import pytest
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+import regintel.api as api_module
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Pytest fixture
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def client(db_path, monkeypatch):
+    """TestClient bound to a tmp DB; REGINTEL_DB env var set (mirrors test_api.py)."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("REGINTEL_DB", db_path)
+    with TestClient(api_module.app) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# AC1 — GET / serves HTML containing the required portal strings
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_index_serves_html_with_required_strings(client):
+    """GET / returns 200 with Content-Type text/html and contains the
+    portal's identifying strings: 'RegIntel', 'needs-review', 'irrelevant',
+    'duplicate' and 'Override'.
+    """
+    response = client.get("/")
+
+    # Status 200.
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+
+    # Content-Type header starts with 'text/html' (FileResponse sets
+    # media_type='text/html' which FastAPI surfaces as 'text/html; charset=utf-8').
+    content_type = response.headers.get("content-type", "")
+    assert content_type.startswith("text/html"), (
+        f"expected text/html content-type, got {content_type!r}"
+    )
+
+    body = response.text
+
+    # All five required strings must appear in the served body.
+    for needle in ("RegIntel", "needs-review", "irrelevant", "duplicate", "Override"):
+        assert needle in body, f"served HTML must contain {needle!r}"
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# AC2 — No external script/link assets; no absolute http(s) URLs anywhere
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+# A <script>/<link> tag whose src/href starts with an http(s) URL would be
+# an external asset. We forbid the tag anywhere in the served body.
+_EXTERNAL_SCRIPT_RE = re.compile(
+    r"<script[^>]*\ssrc\s*=\s*['\"]\s*https?://", re.IGNORECASE
+)
+_EXTERNAL_LINK_RE = re.compile(
+    r"<link[^>]*\shref\s*=\s*['\"]\s*https?://", re.IGNORECASE
+)
+
+# Stricter: any 'http://' or '//' (protocol-relative) reference must not
+# appear in the served body. The portal only uses same-origin relative
+# paths ('/queue', '/metrics', '/events/...').
+_HTTP_URL_RE = re.compile(r"https?://", re.IGNORECASE)
+
+
+def test_index_has_no_external_script_or_link_assets(client):
+    """The served HTML must contain no external <script src=...> or
+    <link href=...> pointing at an absolute URL (no CDN, no external asset).
+    """
+    response = client.get("/")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    body = response.text
+

+        "served HTML must not contain an external <script src='https://...'>"

+    )

+    """The served HTML must contain no 'http://' or 'https://' anywhere.
+
+    All CSS lives in one inline ``<style>`` block and all JS in one inline
+    ``<script>`` block; the page fetches only same-origin relative paths.
+    """
+    response = client.get("/")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    body = response.text
+
+    assert not _HTTP_URL_RE.search(body), (
+        "served HTML must contain no absolute http(s) URLs"
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# AC3 — Bucket filter defaults to 'all' or empty so every bucket is listed
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_bucket_filter_defaults_to_all_or_empty(client):
+    """The bucket filter's default value must be 'all' or the empty string,
+    so the default view lists every bucket (none filtered out).
+
+    The portal exposes this as ``<option value="">All</option>`` — the
+    default selected value is the empty string and the JS initialises
+    ``state.filter = ""``.
+    """
+    response = client.get("/")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    body = response.text
+
+    # Locate the bucket-filter <select> ... </select> block.
+    select_match = re.search(
+        r'<select[^>]*\bid\s*=\s*["\']bucket-filter["\'][^>]*>(.*?)</select>',
+        body,
+        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
+    )

+    inner = select_match.group(1)
+
+    # The first <option> is the default selection (no `selected` attribute
+    # means the first option is selected by HTML spec).

+    # lists every bucket — never a specific bucket.

+        "attribute — the first option is the default by HTML spec"

+    # reachable from the dropdown.

+    the ``required`` attribute so the form cannot submit without them.

+    """
+    response = client.get("/")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers.get("content-type", "").startswith("text/html")

+"""Shared pytest fixtures for the RegIntel test suite.
+
+Provides:
+
+- ``db_path``: an isolated SQLite file path under pytest's tmp-path fixture.
+- ``fake_dial``: a stub DIAL client that mimics the AsyncOpenAI
+  ``chat.completions.create`` call shape used by the copied ``dial/`` source.
+  It returns scripted responses whose ``.choices[0].message.content`` is
+  settable per test and whose ``.usage`` carries ``prompt_tokens`` and
+  ``completion_tokens``. No network call is made and ``.env`` is never read.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+import pytest
+
+from regintel.store import init_db
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _FakeUsage:
+    prompt_tokens: int = 0
+    completion_tokens: int = 0
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _FakeMessage:
+    content: str = ""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _FakeChoice:
+    message: _FakeMessage = field(default_factory=_FakeMessage)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _FakeChatCompletion:
+    choices: List[_FakeChoice] = field(default_factory=lambda: [_FakeChoice()])
+    usage: _FakeUsage = field(default_factory=_FakeUsage)
+
+
+class _FakeCompletions:
+    """Mimics ``openai.resources.chat.completions.Completions``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, parent: "FakeDialClient") -> None:
+        self._parent = parent
+
+    async def create(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        return _FakeChatCompletion(
+            choices=[_FakeChoice(message=_FakeMessage(content=self._parent.content))],
+            usage=_FakeUsage(
+                prompt_tokens=self._parent.prompt_tokens,
+                completion_tokens=self._parent.completion_tokens,
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class _FakeChat:
+    """Mimics ``openai.resources.chat.Chat``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, parent: "FakeDialClient") -> None:
+        self.completions = _FakeCompletions(parent)
+
+
+class FakeDialClient:
+    """Stand-in for the AsyncOpenAI client returned by ``dial.get_async_client()``.
+
+    Usage in a test::
+
+        def test_something(fake_dial):
+            fake_dial.content = "hello"
+            fake_dial.prompt_tokens = 10
+            fake_dial.completion_tokens = 20
+            # ...inject fake_dial where the dial client is consumed...
+            assert fake_dial.chat.completions  # call shape parity
+
+    The interface mirrors the AsyncOpenAI chat.completions.create call shape:
+    a callable ``create`` coroutine on ``chat.completions`` returning an object
+    with ``choices[0].message.content``, ``usage.prompt_tokens`` and
+    ``usage.completion_tokens``.
+    """
+
+    content: str = ""
+    prompt_tokens: int = 0
+    completion_tokens: int = 0
+    model: Optional[str] = None
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.chat = _FakeChat(self)
+        # Record every call shape so tests can assert parity.
+        self.calls: List[dict] = []
+
+    async def complete(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        # Convenience wrapper used by tests that prefer a single entry point.
+        self.calls.append({"args": args, "kwargs": kwargs})
+        return await self.chat.completions.create(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def db_path(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
+    """An isolated SQLite file path under pytest's tmp-path.
+
+    The parent directory is created by ``tmp_path``; ``init_db`` creates the
+    file itself.
+    """
+    path = tmp_path / "regintel.db"
+    init_db(str(path))
+    return path
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def fake_dial() -> FakeDialClient:
+    """A ``FakeDialClient`` whose response content and token counts are settable.
+
+    The fixture does NOT load ``.env`` and does NOT touch the network — it
+    stands in for the DIAL client wherever one would be injected.
+    """
+    return FakeDialClient()

+
+These tests use only the stdlib plus the packages listed in
+``requirements.txt`` (no extra dependencies). They never make a network call
+and never read ``.env``; the ``fake_dial`` fixture is provided for callers
+that want to script DIAL responses.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from regintel import store
+from regintel.models import ClassificationRecord, EventRecord, ReviewRecord
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _make_event(
+    *,
+    event_id: str = "evt-1",
+    raw_text: str = "Some raw regulatory text.",
+    injection_suspected: bool = False,
+    created_at: str = "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
+    detected_at: str = "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
+) -> EventRecord:
+    return EventRecord(
+        event_id=event_id,
+        source_id="src-1",
+        source_name="Test Source",
+        source_type="rss",
+        source_reliability="high",
+        jurisdiction_level="national",
+        jurisdiction_name="US-Federal",
+        detected_at=detected_at,
+        effective_date=None,
+        is_pending_legislation=False,
+        raw_text=raw_text,
+        content_hash="h" * 64,
+        injection_suspected=injection_suspected,
+        created_at=created_at,
+    )
+
+
+def _make_classification(
+    *,
+    event_id: str = "evt-1",
+    bucket: str = "monitor",
+    proposed_bucket: str = "monitor",
+    confidence: float = 0.8,
+    rationale: str = "Looks routine.",
+    topic_tags: list = None,
+    classified_at: str = "2024-01-01T00:00:01",
+    prompt_tokens: int = 100,
+    completion_tokens: int = 50,
+) -> ClassificationRecord:
+    return ClassificationRecord(
+        event_id=event_id,
+        bucket=bucket,
+        proposed_bucket=proposed_bucket,
+        confidence=confidence,
+        rationale=rationale,
+        topic_tags=topic_tags if topic_tags is not None else ["general"],
+        duplicate_of=None,
+        model="claude-haiku-4-5@20251001",
+        prompt_version="v1",
+        prompt_tokens=prompt_tokens,
+        completion_tokens=completion_tokens,
+        cost_usd=0.0001,
+        raw_model_output="{}",
+        classified_at=classified_at,
+    )

+

+# AC6 — default-population behaviour
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+

+

+
+    fetched = store.get_event(str(db_path), "evt-defaults")

+
+
+def test_classification_without_explicit_classified_at(db_path: Path) -> None:
+    store.insert_event(str(db_path), _make_event())
+    classification = ClassificationRecord(
+        event_id="evt-1",
+        bucket="monitor",
+        proposed_bucket="monitor",
+        confidence=0.8,
+        rationale="r",
+        topic_tags=["t"],
+        duplicate_of=None,
+        model="m",
+        prompt_version="v1",
+        prompt_tokens=1,
+        completion_tokens=2,
+        cost_usd=0.0,
+        raw_model_output="{}",

+    datetime.fromisoformat(classification.classified_at)

+    store.append_classification(str(db_path), classification)

+

+def test_review_without_explicit_reviewed_at(db_path: Path) -> None:

+    datetime.fromisoformat(listed[0].reviewed_at)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# init_db idempotency (called out in the story)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def test_init_db_is_idempotent(db_path: Path) -> None:

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# fake_dial fixture — AC2 / AC7 (no network, no .env, call-shape parity)

+    # Drive the coroutine through asyncio without touching the network.

+            model="claude-haiku-4-5@20251001",
+            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
+        )
+    )
+
+    # The AsyncOpenAI call shape the copied dial client uses:
+    assert result.choices[0].message.content == "hello world"
+    assert result.usage.prompt_tokens == 17
+    assert result.usage.completion_tokens == 9

+"""Pytest configuration and shared fixtures for the RegIntel test harness.
+
+This module provides two fixtures:
+
+* ``db_path`` — a per-test temporary SQLite database file path. Tests that
+  exercise ``regintel.store`` should request this fixture and pass its value
+  to every store function (the store API takes the path explicitly so tests
+  never reach for a real on-disk database).
+* ``fake_dial`` — a ``FakeDialClient`` object whose ``chat.completions.create``
+  mirrors the ``AsyncOpenAI`` interface used by downstream classification
+  stories. It is fully scripted (no network, no ``.env`` lookup) so future
+  tests can stand in for the real DIAL gateway.
+
+No test code reads ``.env``, and nothing under ``dial/``, ``docs/`` or
+``.claude/`` is touched by the harness.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Optional
+
+import pytest
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Database fixture
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def db_path(tmp_path: Path) -> str:
+    """Return a path to a fresh, empty SQLite file inside ``tmp_path``.
+
+    The file is created up-front so store functions that open the database
+    lazily (e.g. ``sqlite3.connect(path)``) find a real file at the returned
+    path. The file is removed automatically when ``tmp_path`` is torn down
+    by pytest.
+    """
+    db_file = tmp_path / "regintel_test.db"
+    db_file.touch()
+    return str(db_file)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Fake DIAL client fixture
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _FakeMessage:
+    """Mimics ``openai.types.chat.ChatCompletionMessage``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, content: str) -> None:
+        self.content = content
+
+
+class _FakeChoice:
+    """Mimics ``openai.types.chat.Choice`` (just the parts we use)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, content: str) -> None:
+        self.message = _FakeMessage(content)
+
+
+class _FakeUsage:
+    """Mimics ``openai.types.completion_usage.CompletionUsage``.
+
+    Holds ``prompt_tokens`` and ``completion_tokens`` as plain attributes so
+    tests can assert against token accounting without touching the network.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        prompt_tokens: int = 0,
+        completion_tokens: int = 0,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.prompt_tokens = prompt_tokens
+        self.completion_tokens = completion_tokens
+
+
+class _FakeChatCompletion:
+    """Mimics ``openai.types.chat.ChatCompletion``."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        content: str,
+        prompt_tokens: int = 0,
+        completion_tokens: int = 0,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.choices: list[_FakeChoice] = [_FakeChoice(content)]
+        self.usage = _FakeUsage(
+            prompt_tokens=prompt_tokens,
+            completion_tokens=completion_tokens,
+        )
+
+
+class _FakeCompletionsAPI:
+    """``client.chat.completions`` namespace. Holds the parent for scripted replies."""
+
+    def __init__(self, parent: "FakeDialClient") -> None:
+        self._parent = parent
+        self.last_kwargs: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None
+
+    async def create(self, **kwargs: Any) -> _FakeChatCompletion:
+        """Return a scripted ``_FakeChatCompletion``.
+
+        Accepts ``model``, ``messages`` and any other kwargs the real
+        ``AsyncOpenAI.chat.completions.create`` would. The response shape
+        itself is driven entirely by ``FakeDialClient.script``.
+        """
+        # Stash the kwargs so tests can inspect what was sent.
+        self.last_kwargs = kwargs
+        script = self._parent.next_script()
+        return _FakeChatCompletion(
+            content=script["content"],
+            prompt_tokens=script.get("prompt_tokens", 0),
+            completion_tokens=script.get("completion_tokens", 0),
+        )
+
+
+class _FakeChatAPI:
+    """``client.chat`` namespace. Exposes ``.completions`` like the real client."""
+
+    def __init__(self, parent: "FakeDialClient") -> None:
+        self.completions = _FakeCompletionsAPI(parent)
+
+
+class FakeDialClient:
+    """Drop-in replacement for the ``AsyncOpenAI`` returned by ``dial.client``.
+
+    Mirrors the real surface: ``client.chat.completions.create(...)`` is an
+    ``async`` coroutine that returns an object with
+    ``choices[0].message.content`` and ``usage.{prompt_tokens,
+    completion_tokens}``. No network calls are made; ``.env`` is never read.
+
+    Usage in a test::
+
+        async def test_foo(fake_dial):
+            fake_dial.set_response('{"label": "ok"}', prompt_tokens=12)
+            resp = await fake_dial.chat.completions.create(
+                model="x", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]
+            )
+            assert resp.choices[0].message.content == '{"label": "ok"}'
+            assert resp.usage.prompt_tokens == 12
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.chat = _FakeChatAPI(self)
+        self._scripts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        self._default: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "content": "",
+            "prompt_tokens": 0,
+            "completion_tokens": 0,
+        }
+
+    # -- Scripting API ---------------------------------------------------
+    def set_response(
+        self,
+        content: str,
+        prompt_tokens: int = 0,
+        completion_tokens: int = 0,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Set the response returned by the next ``create`` call.
+
+        Replaces any queued scripts. Subsequent calls reuse this response
+        unless ``queue_response`` adds more.
+        """
+        self._scripts = [
+            {
+                "content": content,
+                "prompt_tokens": prompt_tokens,
+                "completion_tokens": completion_tokens,
+            }
+        ]
+
+    def queue_response(
+        self,
+        content: str,
+        prompt_tokens: int = 0,
+        completion_tokens: int = 0,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Append a response to be consumed in order by successive ``create`` calls."""
+        self._scripts.append(
+            {
+                "content": content,
+                "prompt_tokens": prompt_tokens,
+                "completion_tokens": completion_tokens,
+            }
+        )
+
+    def next_script(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Pop the next scripted reply, falling back to the most recent one."""
+        if self._scripts:
+            return self._scripts.pop(0)
+        return dict(self._default)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def fake_dial() -> FakeDialClient:
+    """Return a fresh ``FakeDialClient`` for the test.
+
+    Each test gets its own instance so queued scripts do not leak between
+    tests.
+    """
+    return FakeDialClient()

@@ -0,0 +1,395 @@
+"""Tests for ``regintel.store``.
+
+Covers:
+
+* Round-trip smoke test — init_db → insert_event → get_event/list_events →
+  append_classification → latest_classification/list_classifications →
+  append_review → list_reviews.
+* Append-only demonstration for classifications and reviews — appending a
+  second classification for the same ``event_id`` produces two rows via
+  ``list_classifications``; ``latest_classification`` returns the newest.
+  The test asserts that the store API exposes no mutator (update/delete) for
+  classification or review rows, demonstrating append-only by inspection of
+  the public surface.
+
+The tests use only the ``db_path`` fixture (a temporary SQLite file) and do
+not touch any real database, network, or ``.env`` file.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlite3
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+from regintel import store
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _make_event(
+    event_id: str,
+    *,
+    is_pending_legislation: bool = True,
+    injection_suspected: bool = False,
+    source_id: str = "src-fca-001",
+    source_name: str = "UK FCA",
+    source_type: str = "regulator",
+    source_reliability: str = "official",
+    jurisdiction_level: str = "national",
+    jurisdiction_name: str = "United Kingdom",
+    raw_text: str = "Sample regulatory notice.",
+    suffix: str = "00",
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Build a fully-populated event dict matching ``regintel.store``'s schema.
+
+    Field names mirror ``_EVENT_COLUMNS`` in ``regintel/store.py``.
+    """
+    return {
+        "event_id": event_id,
+        "source_id": source_id,
+        "source_name": source_name,
+        "source_type": source_type,
+        "source_reliability": source_reliability,
+        "jurisdiction_level": jurisdiction_level,
+        "jurisdiction_name": jurisdiction_name,
+        "detected_at": f"2026-01-15T10:00:{suffix}Z",
+        "effective_date": f"2026-02-15T00:00:{suffix}Z",
+        "is_pending_legislation": is_pending_legislation,
+        "raw_text": raw_text,
+        "content_hash": f"hash-{event_id}",
+        "injection_suspected": injection_suspected,
+        "created_at": f"2026-01-15T10:00:{suffix}Z",
+    }
+
+
+def _make_classification(
+    event_id: str,
+    *,
+    bucket: str = "enforcement",
+    proposed_bucket: str = "enforcement",
+    confidence: float = 0.82,
+    rationale: str = "Reasoning.",
+    topic_tags: list[str] | None = None,
+    duplicate_of: str | None = None,
+    model: str = "claude-haiku-4-5@20251001",
+    prompt_version: str = "v1",
+    prompt_tokens: int = 100,
+    completion_tokens: int = 50,
+    cost_usd: float = 0.0001,
+    raw_model_output: str = "{}",
+    classified_at: str = "2026-01-15T10:01:00Z",
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Build a fully-populated classification dict matching the store schema."""
+    return {
+        "event_id": event_id,
+        "bucket": bucket,
+        "proposed_bucket": proposed_bucket,
+        "confidence": confidence,
+        "rationale": rationale,
+        "topic_tags": list(topic_tags) if topic_tags else [],
+        "duplicate_of": duplicate_of,
+        "model": model,
+        "prompt_version": prompt_version,
+        "prompt_tokens": prompt_tokens,
+        "completion_tokens": completion_tokens,
+        "cost_usd": cost_usd,
+        "raw_model_output": raw_model_output,
+        "classified_at": classified_at,
+    }
+
+
+def _make_review(
+    event_id: str,
+    *,
+    reviewer: str = "analyst@example.com",
+    action: str = "confirm",
+    final_bucket: str = "enforcement",
+    reviewer_rationale: str = "Looks correct.",
+    reviewed_at: str = "2026-01-15T10:05:00Z",
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Build a fully-populated review dict matching the store schema."""
+    return {
+        "event_id": event_id,
+        "reviewer": reviewer,
+        "action": action,
+        "final_bucket": final_bucket,
+        "reviewer_rationale": reviewer_rationale,
+        "reviewed_at": reviewed_at,
+    }
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Round-trip smoke test
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_store_round_trip(db_path: str) -> None:
+    """Insert an event, then a classification, then a review, and read each back."""
+
+    # ---- init_db --------------------------------------------------------
+    store.init_db(db_path)
+
+    # Tables exist after init.
+    tables = {
+        row[0]
+        for row in sqlite3.connect(db_path).execute(
+            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"
+        ).fetchall()
+    }
+    assert {"events", "classifications", "reviews"} <= tables
+
+    # ---- insert_event ---------------------------------------------------
+    event = _make_event(
+        "evt-001",
+        is_pending_legislation=True,
+        injection_suspected=False,
+        raw_text="The minister announced a new AML rule.",
+    )
+    store.insert_event(db_path, event)
+
+    # ---- get_event / list_events ---------------------------------------
+    fetched = store.get_event(db_path, "evt-001")
+    assert fetched is not None
+    assert fetched["event_id"] == "evt-001"
+    assert fetched["source_id"] == "src-fca-001"
+    assert fetched["source_name"] == "UK FCA"
+    assert fetched["is_pending_legislation"] is True
+    assert isinstance(fetched["is_pending_legislation"], bool)
+    assert fetched["injection_suspected"] is False
+    assert isinstance(fetched["injection_suspected"], bool)
+    assert fetched["raw_text"] == "The minister announced a new AML rule."
+
+    events = store.list_events(db_path)
+    assert len(events) == 1
+    assert events[0]["event_id"] == "evt-001"
+    assert events[0]["is_pending_legislation"] is True
+
+    # Missing event returns None.
+    assert store.get_event(db_path, "evt-does-not-exist") is None
+
+    # ---- append_classification / latest / list -------------------------
+    classification_v1 = _make_classification(
+        "evt-001",
+        rationale="First-pass classification rationale.",
+        topic_tags=["anti-money-laundering", "enforcement"],
+        classified_at="2026-01-15T10:01:00Z",
+    )
+    classification_id_v1 = store.append_classification(db_path, classification_v1)
+    assert isinstance(classification_id_v1, int)
+    assert classification_id_v1 >= 1
+
+    latest = store.latest_classification(db_path, "evt-001")
+    assert latest is not None
+    assert latest["classification_id"] == classification_id_v1
+    assert latest["event_id"] == "evt-001"
+    assert latest["bucket"] == "enforcement"
+    assert latest["confidence"] == 0.82
+    # topic_tags is stored as JSON-encoded text and rehydrated to a list.
+    assert latest["topic_tags"] == ["anti-money-laundering", "enforcement"]
+    assert isinstance(latest["topic_tags"], list)
+    assert latest["prompt_tokens"] == 100
+    assert latest["completion_tokens"] == 50
+
+    listed = store.list_classifications(db_path, "evt-001")
+    assert [row["classification_id"] for row in listed] == [classification_id_v1]
+
+    # ---- append_review / list ------------------------------------------
+    review_v1 = _make_review(
+        "evt-001",
+        reviewer="analyst@example.com",
+        action="confirm",
+        final_bucket="enforcement",
+        reviewer_rationale="Looks correct.",
+    )
+    review_id_v1 = store.append_review(db_path, review_v1)
+    assert isinstance(review_id_v1, int)
+    assert review_id_v1 >= 1
+
+    reviews = store.list_reviews(db_path, "evt-001")
+    assert [row["review_id"] for row in reviews] == [review_id_v1]
+    assert reviews[0]["reviewer"] == "analyst@example.com"
+    assert reviews[0]["action"] == "confirm"
+    assert reviews[0]["final_bucket"] == "enforcement"
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Append-only demonstration
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_classifications_are_append_only(db_path: str) -> None:
+    """Appending a second classification for the same event yields two rows.
+
+    ``list_classifications`` returns them in ascending ``classification_id``
+    order; ``latest_classification`` returns the newest (largest id). The
+    second insertion must not overwrite the first.
+    """
+    store.init_db(db_path)
+
+    store.insert_event(
+        db_path,
+        _make_event(
+            "evt-002",
+            is_pending_legislation=True,
+            raw_text="Draft regulation on data residency.",
+            suffix="01",
+        ),
+    )
+
+    first_id = store.append_classification(
+        db_path,
+        _make_classification(
+            "evt-002",
+            rationale="First-pass rationale: low-confidence bucket guess.",
+            topic_tags=["data-residency"],
+            confidence=0.55,
+            prompt_version="v1",
+            classified_at="2026-01-16T09:01:00Z",
+        ),
+    )
+    second_id = store.append_classification(
+        db_path,
+        _make_classification(
+            "evt-002",
+            rationale="Refined rationale after reclassification.",
+            topic_tags=["data-residency", "cross-border"],
+            confidence=0.91,
+            prompt_version="v1",
+            classified_at="2026-01-16T09:02:00Z",
+        ),
+    )
+
+    assert isinstance(first_id, int)
+    assert isinstance(second_id, int)
+    assert second_id > first_id, "classification_id must monotonically increase"
+
+    rows = store.list_classifications(db_path, "evt-002")
+    assert len(rows) == 2, "append-only: two appends must produce two rows"
+    assert [row["classification_id"] for row in rows] == [first_id, second_id]
+
+    # First row is untouched.
+    assert rows[0]["confidence"] == 0.55
+    assert rows[0]["rationale"] == "First-pass rationale: low-confidence bucket guess."
+    assert rows[0]["topic_tags"] == ["data-residency"]
+
+    # Second row is appended after it.
+    assert rows[1]["confidence"] == 0.91
+    assert rows[1]["rationale"] == "Refined rationale after reclassification."
+    assert rows[1]["topic_tags"] == ["data-residency", "cross-border"]
+
+    # latest_classification returns the newest (largest classification_id).
+    latest = store.latest_classification(db_path, "evt-002")
+    assert latest is not None
+    assert latest["classification_id"] == second_id
+    assert latest["rationale"] == "Refined rationale after reclassification."
+
+
+def test_reviews_are_append_only(db_path: str) -> None:
+    """Appending two reviews for the same event yields two rows.
+
+    Reviews are append-only too: the public ``regintel.store`` module exposes
+    ``append_review`` and ``list_reviews`` but no update/delete for reviews.
+    """
+    store.init_db(db_path)
+
+    store.insert_event(
+        db_path,
+        _make_event(
+            "evt-003",
+            is_pending_legislation=False,
+            raw_text="Consultation paper on operational resilience.",
+            suffix="02",
+        ),
+    )
+
+    first_review_id = store.append_review(
+        db_path,
+        _make_review(
+            "evt-003",
+            reviewer="reviewer.a@example.com",
+            action="reject",
+            final_bucket="guidance",
+            reviewer_rationale="Tighten the summary before confirming.",
+            reviewed_at="2026-01-17T08:01:00Z",
+        ),
+    )
+    second_review_id = store.append_review(
+        db_path,
+        _make_review(
+            "evt-003",
+            reviewer="reviewer.b@example.com",
+            action="confirm",
+            final_bucket="enforcement",
+            reviewer_rationale="Revised summary accepted.",
+            reviewed_at="2026-01-17T08:02:00Z",
+        ),
+    )
+
+    assert isinstance(first_review_id, int)
+    assert isinstance(second_review_id, int)
+    assert second_review_id > first_review_id
+
+    rows = store.list_reviews(db_path, "evt-003")
+    assert len(rows) == 2
+    assert [row["review_id"] for row in rows] == [first_review_id, second_review_id]
+    assert rows[0]["action"] == "reject"
+    assert rows[1]["action"] == "confirm"
+
+
+def test_store_exposes_no_classification_or_review_mutator(db_path: str) -> None:
+    """Demonstrate append-only by inspecting the public store surface.
+
+    The store module must offer only append/read helpers for classifications
+    and reviews. If a mutator (update/delete) ever leaks into the public
+    surface, this test fails so append-only is enforced at the API boundary.
+    """
+    forbidden_substrings = (
+        "update_classification",
+        "delete_classification",
+        "replace_classification",
+        "update_review",
+        "delete_review",
+        "replace_review",
+    )
+    public_names = sorted(getattr(store, "__all__", None) or dir(store))
+    leaks = [
+        name
+        for name in public_names
+        if any(sub in name for sub in forbidden_substrings)
+    ]
+    assert leaks == [], (
+        "regintel.store leaked mutator(s) for append-only data: "
+        f"{leaks}. Classification and review rows are append-only."
+    )
+
+    # Positive control: the append/read helpers ARE present.
+    expected = {
+        "append_classification",
+        "append_review",
+        "latest_classification",
+        "list_classifications",
+        "list_reviews",
+    }
+    missing = expected - set(public_names)
+    assert not missing, f"regintel.store missing expected helpers: {missing}"
+
+
+def test_duplicate_event_id_raises_integrity_error(db_path: str) -> None:
+    """event_id is TEXT PRIMARY KEY — re-inserting the same id raises IntegrityError."""
+    store.init_db(db_path)
+
+    event = _make_event(
+        "evt-dup",
+        is_pending_legislation=False,
+        raw_text="Duplicate test.",
+        suffix="03",
+    )
+    store.insert_event(db_path, event)
+
+    with pytest.raises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
+        store.insert_event(db_path, event)
